title: Study Path: FAANG Interview Prep
oneLiner: A week-by-week plan for big-tech interviews: coding, system design, object-oriented design and behavioral rounds, sized to your level, target role and weekly hours.
keyTakeaway: Cover the right things in the right order, drill the small building blocks every week, and keep checking where you're weakest. Doing everything once is less use than doing the core well.
explanation:
This is the same plan as Study Plan and Readiness in the Interview Prep section, opened on the interview path. Pick where you start (new to programming, comfortable, or experienced but rusty on interviews), what the interviews are for, and how many hours a week you have, and it lays out the weeks. Every week starts with a short Today's reps session of building blocks, and slack weeks are kept for redoing what didn't stick.

The readiness tab shows the evidence for each area: what you have covered, what you passed with help, what you passed on your own, and what you did against the clock. Switch to the Well-rounded IT & CS path at the top if you want broad knowledge rather than interview practice. Your plan is saved in this browser.
